# Slider

Select a range of values on a defined interval.
See [Slider guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/slider/design/)

<Canvas of={RangesliderStories.Basic} />

```css
.mb-1 {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}
.w-1\/4 {
  width: 25%;
}
.w-1\/2 {
  width: 50%;
}
.l-1\/4 {
  left: 25%;
}
.l-3\/4 {
  left: 75%;
}
```

## Examples

### Sizes

A large variant is available for touch screens.

<Canvas of={RangesliderStories.Sizes} />

### Dark Mode

<Canvas of={RangesliderStories.Dark} />

```css
.bg-dark {
  background-color: #111;
}
.p-1 {
  padding: 1rem;
}
```

### Ticks

<Canvas of={RangesliderStories.Ticks} />

```css
.l-1\/2 {
  left: 50%;
}
.l-1\/1 {
  left: 100%;
}
```

### Vertical

<Canvas of={RangesliderStories.Vertical} />

```css
.h-360 {
  height: 360px;
}
.h-1\/4 {
  height: 25%;
}
.t-1\/2 {
  top: 50%;
}
.t-3\/4 {
  top: 75%;
}
.t-1\/1 {
  top: 100%;
}
```
